  FROM m

  SELECT
    m.CustomerKey AS ck,
    m.orders AS orders,
    m.amt    AS amt,
    m.aov    AS aov,
    multiIf(
      lower(trimBoth(coalesce(cu.FirstName, ''))) IN ('', 'not provided', 'unknown', 'n/a', 'na', '-', 'null')
      OR lower(trimBoth(coalesce(cu.LastName, ''))) IN ('', 'not provided', 'unknown', 'n/a', 'na', '-', 'null'),
